title: Edge Removal
source_topic: ICPC / The 2020 Asia Can Tho Regional Contest
statement: A student has drawn an undirected weighted graph that may admit several minimum spanning trees. He wants to delete as few edges as possible so that exactly one minimum spanning tree remains; the weight deleted is irrelevant. The task is to report that minimum count and one such set of edges, or to report that the graph is disconnected. Graphs carry up to three hundred thousand edges.
